title: 2017 Toyota Camry XSE Hood Repaint and Grille Replacement
summary: Carcis Autobody Repair repainted the hood and replaced the front grille on a 2017 Toyota Camry XSE.
story: A 2017 Toyota Camry XSE required front-end paint and body work at Carcis Autobody Repair. The project involved replacing the front grille and repainting the vehicle's hood.

Installing a replacement front grille requires unbolting top trim clips and carefully detaching the bumper assembly. Once the damaged component is removed, the new grille is aligned and snapped into place to restore correct factory fitment around the headlights and center emblem.

Refinishing the black hood involved prepping the surface through uniform sanding and cleaning. The panel was sprayed with fresh black basecoat and clear coat, then cured and buffed to ensure a deep, glossy finish that matches the surrounding panels.
